hypotheses.P0_four_path_backward_program_is_exact: The four weight-derived path adjoints and behavioral effects recompose saved native effects to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.P1_two_backward_paths_are_sufficient: The discovery-selected two path types retain at least 0.90 behavioral fidelity for prediction, target, and margin on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.P2_three_backward_paths_are_high_fidelit: The discovery-selected three path types retain at least 0.95 behavioral fidelity for prediction, target, and margin on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.P3_attention_response_is_material: Removing both attention-backward paths leaves less than 0.95 fidelity for at least one component on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_final_mlp_response_is_material: Removing both final-MLP-backward paths leaves less than 0.95 fidelity for at least one component on every corpus.
hypotheses.P5_path_order_transfers_ood: For two- and three-path programs, each OOD aggregate fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.P6_short_program_can_have_broad_path_vec: At least one individual path family has write-adjoint R90 of at least 128 on discovery.
hypotheses.P7_context_executed_program_resolves_sta: The exact four-path program is at least 0.50 better than the best static shared suffix behavioral fidelity for every fitted component and corpus.
